summary: ARGENX SE filed a Form 6-K on August 17, 2026, announcing positive topline results from its Phase 3 ALKIVIA trial of efgartigimod in autoimmune myositis. The study met its primary endpoint with a 15.4-point greater improvement in Total Improvement Score over placebo (p=0.0011). The press release and investor presentation are incorporated by reference into existing S-8 registration statements. This is a routine clinical trial update, not a special-situation transaction. There are no deal terms, M&A activity, or corporate structural events. The filing serves solely to disclose trial efficacy and safety data to US investors.
